name: znetwork_find_player_record_by_key
description: zNetwork::FindPlayerRecordByKey walks the global player-record sentinel list and returns the record whose player key matches the requested key.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; final byte matching should be handled with the coherent zNetwork player-record/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48ba60 validates reading g_zNetwork_PlayerRecordList->sentinelNode, iterating next links until the sentinel, comparing each record playerKey, returning the matching record, and returning null when no node matches.
The native player-record accessor smoke verifies matching and missing-key lookups through zNetwork_FindPlayerRecordByKey.
